allowed_changes: one unconditional U.S. session-premium strategy: hold exposure from each real U.S. close to the next real U.S. open and hold cash during the U.S. daytime session
standalone 100% Nasdaq and S&P 500 paths plus one fixed 50/50 combined path
one complementary daytime control using the same real OHLC rows: current open to current close
one CNY cash control and one fixed 0.05% adverse-slippage-per-fill stress
synthetic overnight bar construction may only implement the frozen close-to-next-open economic exposure and exact CNY FX value alignment; it may not introduce a signal filter
comparison_gates: combined overnight CAGR > complementary daytime CAGR
combined overnight Sharpe > complementary daytime Sharpe
combined overnight MDD <= complementary daytime MDD

controls.cash: C-CASH-COMBINED uses the existing CashYieldCNY demand-deposit model over the identical evaluation window
controls.daytime: C-DAYTIME uses the same real U.S. OHLC rows and fixed asset allocations but isolates open-to-close exposure rather than close-to-next-open exposure

expected_outputs: Nasdaq, S&P 500 and fixed 50/50 combined overnight metrics
complementary open-to-close controls, CNY cash control and 0.05% per-fill adverse-slippage stress
round-trip count, win rate, average net return and profit factor
actual gross, minimum cash, zero sentinel take-profit hits and target fingerprints
FX alignment assertion preserving previous-close CNY value
portfolio CSV for every candidate, control and stress path
follow_up_policy: After any formal overnight performance metric is viewed, do not add trend, calendar, volatility, gap, return-sign, weekday, month-end, earnings, VIX, macro, China, or any other filter; do not change the holding interval, choose one index after results, alter the 50/50 weight, change fee/slippage, or search for a favorable overnight definition inside this trial. Any future conditioned overnight strategy must be a separately motivated and preregistered independent lineage, not a rescue of 001.
forbidden_changes: using current-session high/low/close to decide whether to hold the preceding overnight interval
changing close-to-next-open into close-to-VWAP, after-hours, pre-market, next-close or multi-day exposure
testing weekday, calendar, SMA, volatility, drawdown, return-sign, gap, VIX, macro or other conditional filters and selecting the best
dropping Nasdaq or S&P 500 after viewing results
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage, negative weights, gross exposure above 100% or negative cash
changing the 0.005% per-fill fee or hiding the 0.05% adverse-slippage stress
using synthetic prices not mechanically derived from the frozen real OHLC close/open endpoints
hypothesis: The U.S. equity risk premium contains a persistent non-trading-hours component. Unconditionally holding broad U.S. equity exposure from each cash close to the next cash open, while holding cash during the daytime session, should produce a positive and more robust risk-adjusted return than the complementary open-to-close segment after the frozen execution cost, without leverage or timing filters.
objective_gates: both standalone overnight paths have Sharpe > 0
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have combined overnight Sharpe > 0
with 0.05% adverse slippage per fill, combined overnight CAGR > 0 and Sharpe > 0
stress MDD <= 2 times base overnight MDD
actual round trips > 0, sentinel take-profit hits = 0, maximum gross <=100% and minimum cash >=0
research_basis: Cooper, Cliff & Gulen, Return Differences between Trading and Non-Trading Hours: Like Night and Day
Liu & Tse, Overnight returns of stock indexes: Evidence from ETFs and futures
Review of Financial Studies, Overnight Drift
selection_metric: No within-family selection and no conditioning. There is exactly one unconditional overnight economic rule. Validation, research objective attainment and overnight-vs-daytime comparison are reported independently under ATM-SVP-3.

shared_rules.entry: economic entry at previous real U.S. cash close
shared_rules.exit: economic exit at current real U.S. cash open
shared_rules.fx_rule: previous close is valued using previous-session CNY multiplier and current open using current-session CNY multiplier; synthetic bar is mechanically adjusted so existing backtest conversion preserves this exact CNY path
shared_rules.synthetic_bar_high_low: max/min of the two frozen economic endpoints only

strategy_lineage: us-overnight-001 / 美股纯隔夜001; unconditional session-premium strategy independent of V11 allocation, DayK reversal/trend and cross-market relay
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_us_overnight_001.py -> tools/us_overnight_001.swiftpart + tools/us_overnight_001_logic.swift -> mechanically transformed real-OHLC close-to-next-open bars -> BacktestEngine.runResearchIntradayRoundTripStrategyWithTrace
validation_gates: execution stress CAGR and Sharpe remain positive and stress MDD <=2x base MDD
